Shell.menuDescription: Access the tools for your business.
Shell.connectionDescription: Onboarding includes a preview; it does not connect a real number.
Shell.demoNotice: You are exploring the interface. There is no real customer data or live connection.

Workspace.title: Your sales workspace
Workspace.flowCaption: How your conversations, agent and catalog will connect.
Workspace.description: One place for your conversations, catalog and AI team.
Workspace.welcome: It all starts with a conversation
Workspace.welcomeDescription: One space to support, recommend and sell on WhatsApp. Explore your workspace while we prepare the business features.
Workspace.modulesDescription: A dedicated space for each tool, without losing customer context.
Workspace.conversationsDescription: Messages, context and follow-up in one place.
Workspace.agentDescription: Instructions and personality for your sales agent.
Workspace.productsDescription: A catalog ready to support every conversation.
Workspace.setupDescription: The next step will add access screens and a setup assistant for your business, store, agent and WhatsApp connection.
Workspace.preferencesDescription: You can already change the language and choose light, dark or system theme from the header.

Auth.introTitle: Your next sale starts with a conversation.
Auth.introDescription: Set up your business, define your agent and explore how you will help customers on WhatsApp.
Auth.loginDescription: Sign in to your account and continue in your business.
Auth.changePasswordDescription: Enter your email and current password to choose a new one without opening the dashboard. You must know your current password; email verification codes are not available yet.
Auth.registerDescription: Create your account and register your business to get started.
Auth.name: Name
Auth.passwordHint: Use at least 8 characters, including letters and numbers.
Auth.securityNotice: Sign-in uses a real account and HttpOnly session cookies. Passwords are stored as hashes, never plain text.
Auth.scopeNotice: The business name is saved to the server. The rest of onboarding and commercial modules use temporary demo data; they do not connect WhatsApp or AI.
Auth.sessionError: We could not verify your session. Check your connection and that the API is available.

validation.email: Enter a valid email of up to 254 characters.
validation.password: Enter your password (at most 72 UTF-8 bytes).
validation.registerPassword: Use at least 8 characters, one letter and one number; maximum 72 UTF-8 bytes.
validation.name: Enter a name of 1–100 characters.
validation.businessName: Enter a business name of 1–120 characters.

errors.rejected: The credentials are invalid or the session is no longer available.
errors.conflict: We could not register an account with these details. Review them or sign in if you already have an account.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute before trying again.
errors.forbidden: The request could not be verified. Reload the page and try again.
errors.invalid: Review the form details and the stated limits.
errors.network: Could not connect to the API. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unexpected: We could not complete the request. If you were creating an account, try signing in before submitting another registration.

PasswordStrength.label: Estimated strength
PasswordStrength.tooLong: The password exceeds the maximum of 72 UTF-8 bytes.
PasswordStrength.guidance: Guidance only. A long, unique password is safer; add symbols to strengthen it.

PasswordChange.title: Change password
PasswordChange.description: Protect access to your account. This change applies to all your businesses and devices, not just this workspace.
PasswordChange.passwordHint: Use at least 8 characters, including letters and numbers.
PasswordChange.logoutNotice: Saving signs you out of every session, including this one. Sign in again with your new password. Demo drafts will be discarded.
PasswordChange.securityTitle: A password just for this account
PasswordChange.securityHint: Choose a long password you do not use on other services. You can paste it from your password manager. Do not share it with other team members.
PasswordChange.recoveryHint: You need to know your current password. Email password recovery is not available yet.
PasswordChange.success: Password updated. All previous sessions have been signed out. Sign in with your new password.

validation.current: Enter your current password (no more than 72 UTF-8 bytes).
validation.password: Use at least 8 characters, one letter and one number; maximum 72 UTF-8 bytes.
validation.different: Your new password must be different from your current password.

errors.credentials: The email or current password is incorrect, or the account is unavailable. Check your details and enter the passwords again.
errors.current: Your current password is incorrect. Enter the passwords again.
errors.sessionChanged: The account changed in another tab. Verify your session before trying again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and enter the passwords again.
errors.forbidden: The request could not be verified. Reload the page before trying again.
errors.invalid: Check the indicated limits and enter the passwords again.
errors.uncertain: We could not confirm the result. Your password may already have changed. Try signing in with your new password before repeating the change.

Onboarding.title: Shape your business
Onboarding.description: Continue with the business you registered. Its name is saved when you finish; the rest of the setup is a demo.
Onboarding.temporary: The saved name is loaded from your account. Unsaved changes and the remaining progress only last while you navigate; reloading or logging out clears them.

business.title: Your business
business.description: Review the name you registered; you can update it when you finish. The description is only used in the demo.

store.title: Store and hours
store.description: Set the currency, time zone and daily opening hours.

agent.title: Your AI agent
agent.description: Choose how your agent introduces itself and the instructions it follows in the demo.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp
whatsapp.description: Explore the visual connection flow. You can skip the number and continue without connecting anything.

summary.title: Review and finish
summary.description: Check your details before completing the demo setup.

fields.businessDescription: What you sell and to whom

validation.name: Enter 2–80 characters.
validation.businessName: Enter 1–120 characters for the business name.
validation.phone: Enter at least 6 national number digits, without local dialing prefixes. Including the selected calling code, use 8–15 digits.
validation.hours: Enter valid times; closing time must be after opening time.

Onboarding.phoneHint: We add {code} automatically. Enter a fictional national number with its area code, without a trunk prefix or country code. No messages will be sent.
Onboarding.hoursHint: Daily hours only; overnight shifts are not supported.
Onboarding.whatsappDescription: No Meta flow is opened, no QR code is scanned and no number is verified. This control only changes the visual demo state.
Onboarding.previewReady: Preview ready · WhatsApp is still not connected
Onboarding.finishNotice: Finishing saves the business name to the server (OWNER or ADMIN role required). Everything else remains a demo, without WhatsApp or AI connections.
Onboarding.simulateFailure: Simulate a failure on finish (uncheck it to retry).
Onboarding.saveError: Could not confirm the save. Check your connection and OWNER or ADMIN permissions. If you enabled the simulated failure, uncheck it. The name may have been saved if the response was lost; no automatic retry is performed.
Onboarding.cardDescription: Prepare your business, store and agent with the five-step setup assistant.
Onboarding.completedDescription: The name of {business} is saved to your account. The store, agent and other setup details remain a temporary demo.

Modules.title: This space is being prepared
Modules.description: Navigation and themes are available. The functional interface for this module will be added in the next stages of the plan.
Modules.notice: No real operations or business data are available at this stage.
